resources.string: Missing Hail icons after restoring a launcher backup? Tap for the recovery steps.

1. Keep the original Nova backup. Install Hail and the target apps in the same Android profile, and select Nova as Home.
2. Restore your Hail settings backup if needed. Recreate any shortcuts with custom tags or actions first, using their original settings.
3. Use Add all apps to Home screen to recreate the remaining standard app shortcuts.
4. Restore the original Nova backup again so Nova can match the shortcuts to their saved positions.
Refresh Home screen shortcuts repairs icons and actions for records Android still has. A Nova backup alone cannot recreate a native shortcut that Android has lost.
